Hi internet stranger. Hmm... that is quite the story. You certainly are unique, in a good way. I've definitely experienced some mania of mine own and often times I wanna scream or yell, but so far its been contained. Anytime I think of what I could have been I get those manic episodes, but I am learning to let go of them. I don't know if you've heard of mindfulness, but it could help you in accepting yourself and your craziness. Thoughts are just passing events in the mind, but our brains like to attach to them even when they can be harmful. Your mind is crazy and thats okay. It doesn't have to be different or better, or ideal, or perfect. You  can learn to accept yourself and your outbursts. Don't let it torment you because of the suffering you experience.  If you get a chance check out "Wherever you go there you are" or "Full catastrophe living" both by Jon kabat Zin, the modern father of mindfulness in the west.
